title: Dog with valid pass, not in carrier

turns.user: I have a valid Budapest pass and want to bring one dog on a tram within Budapest. Does it need its own ticket?
turns.agent:
If your Budapest pass is valid, one dog can travel free on a tram within Budapest, provided the dog is not travelling in a fully closed carrier. Keep the dog on a leash and muzzle, and carry valid animal vaccination documentation. If the dog is in a suitable fully closed carrier, it can travel without a separate animal ticket as well.

This is based on my limited 5 November 2026 knowledge snapshot, not a live policy check. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport page for the current conditions. I’m an independent demo, not affiliated with BKK.

turns.user: The dog won't be in a carrier. What safety rules should I follow?
turns.agent:
Since your dog will be outside a carrier, keep it on a leash and muzzled on the tram. Carry its valid animal vaccination documentation as well. With your valid Budapest pass, the snapshot supports one dog travelling free on a tram within Budapest.

These conditions come from the limited 5 November 2026 snapshot; I haven’t live-checked BKK’s current rules. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport page for current details.
